review.why: Converts .docx files to Markdown with a bundled script so they are read accurately, folders included.
review.summary: Runs a bundled Python script (MarkItDown) to turn .docx into a Markdown file plus extracted images before the agent analyzes it, for single files or whole folders. Includes a setup guide, output rules (next to the source by default) and a troubleshooting table. Mixed folders call the sibling PDF and Excel skills.
strengths: Clear output structure and default location rules
Extracts real images instead of placeholder data URIs
cautions: Needs Python and the markitdown package installed
Insists on calling sibling skills for PDF and Excel in mixed folders
